2610.13935.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
2610.13935.paper_summary: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.
2610.13935.paper_summary_zh: 解釋機器學習模型預測是一個核心挑戰，特別是對於黑箱視覺模型。基於概念的歸因方法使用人類可理解的概念來解釋模型。現有的基於概念的方法僅能解釋分類和回歸模型。它們需要訪問模型權重或大型概念標註數據集，而大多數方法無法提供圖像級別的歸因。我們提出了 Hide and Seek (HnS)，這是一種新的概念級別歸因方法，無需訪問模型權重或標註的概念數據集。HnS 可以解釋廣泛的視覺模型。給定一個概念和圖像集，HnS 使用視覺-語言模型檢索與概念對齊的圖像，定位每個圖像中的概念，遮罩定位區域，並通過測量原始圖像和遮罩圖像之間黑箱模型輸出的變化來衡量歸因。這使得通過直接測量模型的行為並支持局部歸因來實現真實的歸因。我們在 CelebA 和 COCO-Stuff 上驗證了 HnS。與現有方法相比，HnS 與真實歸因的協調性更好。我們展示了 HnS 在多樣任務上的適用性，包括圖像標題生成和衛星圖像分割，而沒有現有的概念歸因方法可以使用。我們在補充材料中提供了匿名代碼。
